title: Bug: Everflow TD3 policer test fails on mirror-port TX-drop assertion
author: pdam-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Everflow policer validation can fail on TD3 because the test asserts that the
  mirror port has no TX drops after the PTF policer traffic validation.

The PTF policer validation itself succeeds and receives the expected mirrored
packets after rate limiting, but the test later fails in assert_no_tx_drops_on_mirror_port.

The existing logic already skips the queue TX-drop assertion on TH2/TD3 and
skips the interface TX-drop assertion on TH2. TD3 should use the same skip
condition for the interface TX-drop assertion.


### Steps to Reproduce

 Run the Everflow policer testcase on a TD3 fixed-testbed dt topology:

  sudo ./run_tests.sh \
    -n dt \
    -m individual \
    -p everflow_td3_policer_logs \
    -r \
    -t any,util,dualtor,t0 \
    -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml \
    -u \
    -c everflow/test_everflow_testbed.py::TestEverflowV4IngressAclIngressMirror::test_everflow_dscp_with_policer


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

 **Actual behavior:**
  The IPv4 policer traffic/rate validation passes in PTF, but the test fails
  afterward on TD3 with mirror-port TX drops:

  Expected no tx drops on mirror port Ethernet112/Ethernet116/Ethernet120,
  but found around 30K drops.

  **Expected behavior:**
  The test should keep validating policer traffic/rate behavior, but should avoid
  platform-unreliable mirror-port TX-drop counter assertions on TH2/TD3.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Failed: Expected no tx drops on mirror port Ethernet116, but found 31695
  Failed: Expected no tx drops on mirror port Ethernet120, but found 29926

  Retry examples:
  Failed: Expected no tx drops on mirror port Ethernet112, but found 31599
  Failed: Expected no tx drops on mirror port Ethernet120, but found 30191

  PTF policer validation passed:
  Received 1001 mirrored packets after rate limiting
  Received 1000 mirrored packets after rate limiting
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
SONiC image:
  branch.202605-ars.111785e8-buildimage.84d74ca1aa3b233d1198b3eae18e79c420893493-nightly-2026.08.19.14.40

  Platform:
  x86_64-arista_7050cx3_32c

  HWSKU:
  Arista-7050CX3-32C-C32
```

### Approach

#### What is the motivation for this PR?
On TD3, the PTF Everflow policer traffic/rate validation succeeds, but the test
 can fail afterward on mirror-port TX-drop counters. The failure is not in the
 policer traffic validation itself; it is in the platform-sensitive counter
 assertion.

#### How did you do it?
 Use the existing TH2/TD3 ASIC condition for both mirror-port TX-drop
  assertions. This keeps policer traffic/rate validation enabled and only skips
  the unreliable post-validation counter checks on TH2/TD3.

#### How did you verify/test it?

 IPv4 downstream and upstream policer cases passed. The IPv6 cases skipped
 because the image could not create the IPv6 ERSPAN mirror session.
